findings.evidence: src/app/api/plans/route.ts uses prisma.plan.findMany/create with fields userId, year, month, currency, title; src/app/api/plans/[planId]/route.ts uses prisma.plan.findFirst/delete with an `items` relation ordered by createdAt; src/app/api/plans/[planId]/items/route.ts uses prisma.plannedItem.create with fields planId, title, amountCents, categoryId, note. These are part of this dispatch's codeFiles but no plan/plannedItem table is documented.
findings.message: The Tables section only documents the `user` accessor and states the module's inputs are limited to src/lib/auth.ts, src/lib/db.ts, and src/lib/requireUser.ts. It omits the `plan` and `plannedItem` Prisma model accessors, which are directly evidenced in this doc's own code inputs (prisma.plan.findMany/create/findFirst/delete in plans routes, prisma.plannedItem.create in the items route) with concrete fields (userId, year, month, currency, title, createdAt for plan; planId, title, amountCents, categoryId, note for plannedItem). This input-evident material is silently missing from the Tables section.
